cot from trigonometry
        L_i,j = { cot(α_ij) + cot(β_ij) if j ∈ N(i)
        L_i,i = -sum_(k for k != i) L_i,k
        where
        L: ℝ^(n×n)
        α: ℝ^(n×n)
        β: ℝ^(n×n)
        N: ℤ -> {ℤ}

import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, α, β, N):
        α = np.asarray(α, dtype=np.float64)
        β = np.asarray(β, dtype=np.float64)
        n = α.shape[1]
        assert α.shape == (n, n)
        assert β.shape == (n, n)
        # L_i,j = { cot(α_ij) + cot(β_ij) if j ∈ N(i)
        Lij_0 = []
        Lvals_0 = []
        for i in range(1, n+1):
            for j in range(1, n+1):
                if (j) in N(i):
                    Lij_0.append((i-1, j-1))
                    Lvals_0.append(1/np.tan(α[i-1, j-1]) + 1/np.tan(β[i-1, j-1]))
        sparse_0 = scipy.sparse.coo_matrix((Lvals_0, np.asarray(Lij_0).T), shape=(n, n))
        self.L = sparse_0
        for i in range(1, n+1):
            sum_0 = 0
            for k in range(1, self.L.shape[1]+1):
                if(k != i):
                    sum_0 += self.L.tocsr()[i-1, k-1]
            Lij_0.append((i - 1, i - 1))
            Lvals_0.append(-sum_0)
        self.L = scipy.sparse.coo_matrix((Lvals_0, np.asarray(Lij_0).T), shape=(n, n))
